checkpoint_selection: last EMA at the declared update budget

conversion_check.description: Encode/decode demonstration targets through the chunk TCP frame and exponential coordinates; decoded IK FK must match commanded TCP position/rotation and unchanged gripper within maximum error 0.005. Nonunique IK is permitted and explicit solver diagnostics are returned.

contract.cut_relation: Preserves every action in each assigned [1120,1500) segment, including incoming [1120,1270) and outgoing [1380,1500) overlap. Reanchoring occurs only at the framework's replan boundary; temporal slots and masks are unchanged.
contract.output_semantics: Each slot is an unnormalized Cartesian target [translation(3 metres), rotation vector(3 radians), gripper(1)] for T_chunk_start_tcp^-1*T_command. The chunk anchor is the newest causal tcp_pose and is fixed during the sampled chunk. Slots are t-1 through t+14 and execution uses slots 1-8. Decoding applies the SO(3) exponential map, composes with the anchor, and calls panda_kinematics.solve_ik from freshly measured qpos. Gripper is passed through unchanged.
contract.parameter_semantics: No high-level numeric parameters. The caller passes an empty object and selects this policy for a valid but off-timing intermediate state. At every replan, the newest measured tcp_pose is the chunk action anchor.
